HF_Nets_National.description: National/international HF amateur nets with fixed frequencies: Hurricane Watch Net, SATERN, Maritime Mobile Service Network, NYS RACES, plus 20/40/80m nets from netfinder.radio.

Time_Standard_Stations.description: WWV, WWVH, and CHU time/frequency standard broadcasts. Receive-only reference.

Monitor_Only_Military_USCG.description: HF-GCS (USAF), MARS, Canadian Forces HF, and USCG NMN Chesapeake weather broadcasts. Receive-only.

Shortwave_Broadcast.description: WWCR, WBCQ, Radio Havana Cuba, Radio Romania International, and WRMI - popular English-language shortwave broadcasters receivable in the eastern US. Receive-only.

AMRRON_Nets.description: AmRRON national/regional voice and digital (Contestia 4/250) nets, from amrron.com's own current nets page. Digital nets are programmed at their underlying USB/LSB carrier frequency (decoded via fldigi or similar).
